blocking_finding.cause: Failure diagnosis uses Windows default text newlines; verification inventories raw local bytes. Git normalizes JSON to LF and checkout may expand unqualified partial.txt. Worker portable probe copies raw bytes and misses real Git normalization.
blocking_finding.effect: Required --check fails from exact delivered Git commit before complete fixture verification.
blocking_finding.correction: Deterministic fixture byte serialization/attributes plus real isolated Git clean/checkout roundtrip; fresh bound evidence, no historical hash rewrite.

diagnostic_reconstruction_only.interpretation: Exact recorded raw-byte reconstruction passes full replay, seven artifact and twelve binding corruptions, and authenticates 10800 reference ledger rows. This diagnoses the defect; it does not accept the canonical checkout.
